jira_issue.description: Experimental. Jira Cloud issue lifecycle and unambiguous single-label changes. Closed/reopened means resolution set/cleared, not a guessed status name. Multi-label changelog string deltas are not normalized.

labels.description: A current issue label; not necessarily the label changed by this delivery.

status.description: Current workflow status name, not a lifecycle transition.

sender.description: Jira account ID of the actor; not dispatch authorization.

linear_issue.description: Experimental. Linear Issue data-change events. Terminal timestamp changes and label ID set differences require complete data/updatedFrom evidence. IssueLabel definition events are not issue labeling.

organization-id.description: Required Linear organization ID; configured beside types.

team-id.description: Optional Linear team model ID, when delivered; configured beside organization-id.

labels.description: A current label ID, not its name and not necessarily the changed label.

sender.description: Actor ID, when present; not dispatch authorization.
